node.statement: Unit norm from the permitted corner-algebra input: by one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing, Q is nonvanishing. Apply lem-compcb-corner-algebra with P=Q. It supplies universal C_ca<infinity and e_ca>0 such that S_Q is an extended gamma-C*-algebra with gamma=C_ca e and unit u_Q. The registered def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra and epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms give |||u_Q||-1|<=gamma. Thus, after imposing e<=min{e_ca,1/(2 max{C_ca,1})}, 1/2<=||u_Q||<=3/2 and u_Q is nonzero.
